writing.overall_comment: A well-scoped, clearly described PM agent with good role framing, but it needs explicit output contracts and boundary/handback rules to be production-ready.

dimensions.name: Delegation fit
dimensions.comment: The description clearly names trigger scenarios (requirements analysis, feature breakdown, user stories, scope planning), giving a main agent enough signal to route reliably.

dimensions.name: Prompt quality
dimensions.comment: Role, principles, and worked examples are strong, but there is no explicit output contract specifying the expected deliverable format (e.g., PRD/story template) or success criteria.

dimensions.name: Boundaries
dimensions.comment: The prompt never states what the subagent must not do (e.g., avoid implementation details or architectural decisions) nor when to hand back to the main agent.

dimensions.name: Conciseness
dimensions.comment: Content is tight and scannable with minimal filler, well within a reasonable token budget for a subagent prompt.

suggestions: In the subagent prompt, add a 'Handback criteria' section stating exactly when the subagent should stop and return control to the main agent.
In the subagent prompt, add a 'Must not do' section that explicitly prohibits producing implementation details or making architectural decisions.
In the subagent prompt, add an output contract section defining the expected deliverable format (e.g., PRD/story template) and success criteria.
